Amazon Cargo Plane Crash Kills Five in Miami

An Amazon-branded cargo plane overran a runway at Miami airport on Sunday, crashing into multiple vehicles and catching fire. At least five people were killed in the incident. Three individuals were transported to trauma centers in critical condition, and two others received treatment at a local hospital. The cause of the crash is under investigation.
